name: Love Is a Canvas
source: After being accused of plagiarism, you thought your career as an artist was over. No matter how much your beautiful artist friend tries to convince you, you just can’t get yourself to display your work… But one day, you decide to paint the girl of your dreams on a blank canvas and before you know it… she appears at your door! It seems like everything you paint about her seems to come true! Could you really have brought her life just by painting her? With a new sense of courage, you reenter the gallery scene where you meet an up and coming new artist that encourages you more! But as you paint more and more, you begin to wonder if this girl really is the girl that you painted… Is your true love nothing more than a figment of your imagination? Or could she be more real than you could ever imagine?
translation: 在被指控抄袭后，你认为你的艺术家生涯已经结束了。无论你美丽的艺术家朋友如何试图说服你，你就是无法让自己展示你的作品……但是有一天，你决定在一张空白画布上画下你梦想中的女孩，在你意识到之前……她出现在你家门口！看起来你所描绘的关于她的一切似乎都成真了！你真的可以通过画她来给她带来生命吗？带着新的勇气，你重新进入画廊场景，在那里你遇到了一位崭露头角的新艺术家，他给你更多的鼓励！但随着你画得越来越多，你开始怀疑这个女孩是否真的是你画的女孩……你的真爱只不过是你想象中的虚构吗？或者她会比你想象的更真实吗？
